declared: 2026-10-25, after the scan's off and phenotype results had both been seen. v1, with its two amendments of 2026-10-22, is kept byte-identical in its own file, and everything it declares stays in force except what the amendment below sets.
drafted_by: a coding agent (Claude Code), from the owner's decision recorded in #1050

amendments.change: Phenotype becomes the primary strain-rollup scope, and off the declared sensitivity. Results of both scopes had been seen, so this is a post-results choice of primary scope, and both scopes are always reported side by side, never one alone: a scan names the other scope as the one it must be reported beside, and the scopes report writes the two together. A core of any other scope is still refused, and a core that records no strain_rollup parameter (built before #828) is still read as off, now the sensitivity. Nothing a scan computes on a given core changes.
amendments.reason: The owner decided on 2026-10-25 that phenotype is the primary strain-rollup scope everywhere, the scan included (#1050). Phenotype is the repository's primary scope (#788) and the scope of the other analyses' primary results, such as the tracked outputs regenerated from the final rerun; the scan's primary scope now agrees with them.
amendments.known_when_amended: Made after results. The scan's results on both scopes had been seen. Off: protocol v1 on the final rerun's Tier 1+2 x off core at commit 511c891, reported in docs/reviews/2026-10-23-final-rerun-record.md, where PD/HIV/CRC with cellulose catabolic process ranked 1,368 of 5,984 triples by U6 p for the mean pairwise Jaccard distance (p = 0.35) and 3,446 for the three-way core (p = 0.82), and the lowest U6 p for the mean distance among the 59,820 tested triple-trait rows was 0.00024. Phenotype: a run of the same recipe on 2026-10-24 (protocol v1, where phenotype was the declared sensitivity) on the final rerun's Tier 1+2 x phenotype core at commit 511c891 (core run run-ec264369). There, PD/HIV/CRC with cellulose catabolic process ranked 1,368 of 5,984 triples by U6 p for the mean pairwise Jaccard distance (p = 0.3515) and 3,446 for the three-way core (p = 0.822): the same ranks and p-values as off. Its result was used in a presentation; it is outside the repository's recorded evidence.
